title: Ben Pollack photo and Moore's pictures of Bix
summary: Moore explains he posed in a tuxedo for a Ben Pollack club photo, and says he owns pictures of himself and Bix in football uniforms.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: I know it's one of those... I mean, more than I did. You've probably seen me in pictures of Ben Pollack. Awesome. But I was doubling on tuxedos. Uh... I came back from Europe, and Ben... One of his men had him come to New York, and he had to have a picture for the new, uh, club that they were opening, and he had to have...
So he asked me if I'd stand in with my tuxedo on.
Do you have any, uh, pictures yourself that you own of Vicks, of you and Vicks, and any of the Wolverine pictures, or anything like that? I know. Do you remember it, Vicks?

I've got those pictures, the pictures in football uniforms, and things like that. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm. Uh... Maybe I could just ask you about a rehearsal of Paul... I don't know, I'll say it the way you did. Pauli Maris? Pauli Maris. Mary's. Mary's. Mary's. Mary's. Mary's. Pauli Maris. A rehearsal of his house that he had. I wasn't there. I didn't know anybody. I didn't know anybody.
